title: Spielberg's tip about the Ariel School landing in Africa

tellings.quote: on UFOs he should look into this Landing

plain: The film director Steven Spielberg is said to have told someone, by way of Janet Yang, that anyone interested in UFOs "should look into this landing": a craft reportedly seen landing near the Ariel School in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, in the 1990s. The UFO documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this is how he came to the case. It would mean the tip that led him there came from one of Hollywood's best-known directors.
